name: Pricing Tiers
description: Three-tier pricing section with a highlighted recommended plan and per-plan feature lists with included and excluded states.
usage: import PricingTiers from './PricingTiers'; then <PricingTiers /> for the defaults, or pass plans={[...]} with PricingPlan objects to customize. For non-React projects, paste section.html into any Tailwind page; see preview.html for a self-contained rendered example.
